title: The silence of the mountains
text: The night in the mountains was frosty and quiet, only the wind whistling between the rocks. Everyone slept huddled by the fire.

title: Blizzard
text: A blizzard buried the pass in a single night. By morning the camp was under a white quilt and moving on was hard.

title: Avalanche in the distance
text: Somewhere in the valley an avalanche crashed with a roar that shook the camp. Everyone froze waiting for more.

title: Mountain goats
text: A herd of mountain goats crossed the rocks above the camp. The marksmen held their breath but the chamois were out of range.

title: The eagle
text: An eagle flew over the camp with a large prey in its talons. Everyone looked at the sky and then silence fell.

title: Rockfall
text: Stones broke from the slope and rolled down scattering supplies. The crew had to chase everything down the slope.

title: Dwarf caravan
text: A caravan of Dwarfs passed through the pass with mules full of wares. Nobody dared approach those bearded guards.

title: Freezing wind
text: The wind was so sharp tears froze on cheeks. Everyone wrapped faces in scarves and dreamed of warmth.

title: The stone guardian
text: Beside the path stood a stone statue of a Dwarf with an axe. The crew passed it with respect not touching it.

title: Marmots
text: Marmots whistled on the hill like sentries. The crew laughed until one of them bolted.

title: The frozen brook
text: The brook froze and there was no water to drink. Snow had to be melted which cost half a day's fuel.

title: Sun in the mountains
text: The sun rose above the peaks and painted the snow pink. Everyone watched in silence and someone smiled for the first time in weeks.

title: The lost shepherd
text: A shepherd with sheep lost his way in the mountains and walked blindly towards your camp. The crew gave him water and showed the way.

title: Smoke in the valley
text: A thin column of smoke rose from the valley. The crew watched not knowing if it was a settlement or a fire.

title: The rut
text: Mountain stags bellowed at night so loudly the echo carried through whole valleys. Nobody could sleep.

title: The Dwarf mark
text: A Dwarf mark was carved on a rock with a direction beneath it. The crew didn't know whether it was a warning or a guide.

title: The wrecked wagon
text: A merchant wagon lay smashed below a cliff. The crew climbed down and gathered a few things that survived.

title: Howling wolves
text: Wolves in the mountains howl differently than in the forest: longer and lower. The crew added to the fire and listened.

title: The smell of sulphur
text: A smell of sulphur came from a cave in the rock. A few followers wanted to look but the others stopped them.

title: The Kislevite wanderer
text: A lone wanderer from Kislev took shelter in the camp from the blizzard. He shared vodka and tales of winter.

title: The rolling boulder
text: A huge rock rolled through the camp missing the tents by a hair. Nobody was hurt but everyone trembled.

title: The old trail
text: The crew came upon a trail hewn into the rock by old mountaineers. It ran straight and safe across the pass.

title: The frozen corpse
text: A frozen wanderer's corpse in a heavy cloak lay on the slope. The crew buried him under stones and took what might be of use.

title: Holes in the snow
text: Holes appeared in the snow around the camp as if something walked on two feet and heavy. By morning the tracks were gone.

title: Mist in the valley
text: Mist filled the valley like milk and the peaks looked like islands. The crew stood on the slope and watched.

title: The cave
text: A dry cave with a stock of firewood was found in the rock. The crew lit a fire and slept warm.

title: The highlander's hut
text: A highlander invited the crew into his hut and offered smoked cheese. The conversation was short but warm.

title: Thunder in the mountains
text: Thunder in the mountains boomed like collapsing worlds. The crew cowered under a sheet and it all lasted hours.

title: Golden rays
text: The setting sun lit the summit like a golden crown. Everyone fell silent and some crossed themselves.

title: The prospector
text: A prospector with an old shovel poked in the stream. The crew offered him the fire and learned where to look for veins.

title: The drunken Dwarf
text: A drunken Dwarf walked into the camp demanding someone fight him. If he doesn't get a brawl he'll be offended for life.
okText: The bodyguard accepted the challenge, took a few solid blows and they parted like old friends. The Dwarf left a purse and a small keg.

title: The pass blocked
text: Several boulders blocked the passage and the way back is buried. Without strength they can't be moved.
okText: The bodyguard pushed the largest boulder into the abyss with his own hands. The road opened and beyond it a hidden cache was found.

title: Goblin scouting
text: A small band of goblins prowls near the camp. If they notice us they'll bring the rest of the tribe.
okText: The shadow slipped into the dark, silently cut down three goblins and took their loot. The rest withdrew.

title: The burglar
text: Someone crept into your camp and searches for valuables. Everyone sleeps and he's getting closer to the chest.
okText: The shadow woke at the right moment, caught the burglar and took his own pouch. The burglar fled without boots.

title: The eagle on watch
text: A huge eagle circles the camp watching for prey. If it spots something small it will strike.
okText: The marksman shot the eagle from afar and the crew had a feast. The feathers adorned the tents all week.

title: The biting cold
text: The cold is so sharp the stores froze. Meat from the slope is the only hope.
okText: The marksman hunted two mountain goats and returned with all the meat. The supplies were better than ever.

title: Highlanders at the inn
text: Highlanders at the roadside inn dislike outsiders. If the crew can't win them over there'll be trouble.
okText: The provocateur told a few bawdy jokes and bet a bottle on who drinks faster. The highlanders laughed and the crew was warmly received.

title: The remarkable guest
text: A strange man in colourful robes stopped at the camp claiming to be a great wizard. The crew hesitates.
okText: The provocateur played the faithful pupil and the "wizard" put on a spectacular show. The crew got a handful of coins for being extras.

title: The collapsed mine
text: An old mine collapsed nearby and people are trapped inside. Help is needed to dig them out.
okText: The scavenger dug everyone out and found a few valuable things in the rubble. The survivors gave a reward in ore.

title: Rusty tools
text: Tools that could be useful lie in an old miner's hut. Without repair skill they're useless.
okText: The scavenger repaired the tools, sharpened them and sold some to Dwarfs. The profit was decent.

title: The mountain pass
text: The pass is guarded by customs men but your goods must get through. A way must be found.
okText: The carter knew an old smugglers' trail through a gorge. The goods passed unnoticed and the sale on the other side brought a significant profit.

title: The mules
text: A mule caravan lost its guide and wanders the slope. The owners pay for help.
okText: The carter took command of the mules with his voice and calmed them, then led them to the trail. The owners paid and promised to recommend.

title: The stone bridge
text: A stone bridge over a chasm leads to a mine guarded by soldiers. If destroyed the army is delayed.
okText: The arsonist laid a charge under a pillar and blew the bridge at night. The delay gave the crew time and grateful miners paid.

title: The snowbound trail
text: The trail is buried under snow and ice and the road is needed now. A quick way to clear it is required.
okText: The arsonist lit large fires along the trail and melted the ice in an hour. The road opened and on the way a forgotten cache was found.

title: The lost pass
text: The crew lost the pass and circles along the ridge. Mist thickens and the supplies shrink.
okText: The scout read the wind direction, animal tracks and stones and led everyone to the trail. On the way he found a cave with a stock of firewood.

title: The track of a great foot
text: The snow bears a track of a great foot twice the size of a man's. Nobody knows what it is.
okText: The scout examined the tracks and determined they belonged to a bear with a deformed paw. He warned the crew and showed a safe way.

title: The ore dealer
text: A dealer from a Dwarf market offers the crew a few nuggets of ore at a good price. The question is where they come from.
okText: The fence checked the ore's origin, negotiated the price and resold at a profit to a Dwarf smith. Everyone left satisfied.

title: The stolen load
text: The crew took the load of a wagon with unknown marks. If someone recognises the crest there'll be a row.
okText: The fence recognised the merchants' guild marks, erased them and sold the load in another town. Nobody realised.

title: Altitude sickness
text: Several followers suffer headaches and dizziness. The air is too thin and the road still long.
okText: The healer gave them a decoction of mountain herbs and told them to breathe slowly. After a few hours everyone felt better and the healer collected a few coins.

title: Winter fever
text: One follower has been feverish for two days. The medicine stores run out and the road is long.
okText: The healer boiled a decoction of bark and honey, applied wet cloths and managed to bring down the fever. The patient paid what he could.

title: The highlander's challenge
text: A tall highlander in a leather jerkin challenges the crew to a staff duel. If nobody steps up the crew will be shamed.
okText: The duellist accepted and after a spectacular fight got a draw. The highlander shook his hand respectfully and left a purse.

title: Duel on the edge
text: A knight-raider demands a duel on a narrow ledge over a chasm. Someone could fall.
okText: The duellist used the chasm as a weapon, forced the knight to yield and took his sword and purse.

title: The Dwarf messenger
text: A breathless Dwarf with a sealed note begs shelter from the gale. He says little.

title: The old clan's reply
text: After a few days another Dwarf arrives with a clan's thanks. He leaves a pouch and a promise that the crew will be welcome in their hold.

title: The found helm
text: Under a rock lies an old Dwarf helm with an engraved symbol. It seems very old.

title: The elder Dwarf
text: An old Dwarf with a grey beard approaches the camp and asks about the helm. He says it belonged to his ancestor and that he'll pay.

title: The trail in the snow
text: Fresh tracks of several people heading towards the pass are visible in the snow. Nobody knows who they are.

title: The merchants fled
text: The tracks lead to merchants who fled from robbers. They ask for protection and offer part of their wares.

title: The golden vein
text: A thread of gold glitters in the rock in the light. The cleft is narrow.

title: The Dwarf claim
text: After a few days Dwarf miners came to the camp claiming the vein belongs to them. Their leader has an axe and a great sense of dignity.

title: The strange fire
text: In the distance on the slope a fire is visible. Beside it several figures sit motionless.

title: The fire draws near
text: The fire came closer and the motionless figures proved to be the frozen bodies of travellers who tried to warm themselves. All have been dead for weeks.

title: Snowstorm
text: A snowstorm howled all night and nobody left the shelter. In the morning the world was white and the silence oppressive.

title: Mountain ravens
text: Great mountain ravens watched the camp from the rocks. Every now and then one called out as if counting.

title: The Dwarf outpost
text: A Dwarf outpost stands at the pass. The guards ask the purpose of the journey but the crew has a good answer.

title: The cold bath
text: One follower slipped and fell into a mountain lake. His scream rang across the whole valley.

title: The crevasse
text: The crew came upon a crevasse not on the map. It had to be bypassed losing half a day.

title: Fire in the cave
text: A great fire was lit in the cave that seemed to burn without end. The crew slept warm but uneasily.

title: Whistle over the pass
text: Wind whistled over the pass so shrilly it seemed someone was calling. Several followers stopped their ears.

title: Dwarf song
text: From afar came a grim Dwarf song played on horns. The crew sat without a word and the song lasted till dawn.

title: Frozen waterfalls
text: A waterfall froze into a sculpted column of ice. The crew admired its beauty and someone chipped off a piece for a drink.

title: The stone hut
text: A simple hut with a hearth and shelf was hewn in the rock. Someone lived here once and left everything in order.

title: Shooting star
text: A shooting star crossed the sky lighting up the peaks. Everyone fell silent and some made wishes.

title: Sheep bells
text: From the valley came the jingling of sheep bells. The crew watched shepherds drive the flock in for the night.

title: River in the gorge
text: The river roared in the gorge so loud that conversation was impossible. The crew communicated by gestures.

title: Mysterious lights
text: Lights danced on the mountain slope drifting up and down. Nobody went to check.

title: Frost and silence
text: The night was so frosty trees cracked from within. Every crack sounded like a shot.

title: The wounded stag
text: A wounded stag rolled from a rock and fell right beside the camp. The crew made a feast of it.

title: The travelling trader
text: A trader with a mule full of wares stopped at the camp. The crew bought salt and dried meat at a good price.

title: The runaway miner
text: A miner fleeing a count's overseer begged shelter. The crew gave him bread and showed the way over the pass.

title: The rats' den
text: A huge den of rats was found in the cave. The crew backed away not daring to examine it closer.

title: The stone house
text: A ruined stone house stood on the slope. The roof had fallen but the walls held giving shelter from the wind.

title: The goat's trail
text: The crew followed a mountain goat's trail to a remote ledge where they found a few coloured stones. Not valuable but beautiful.

title: Explosion in the distance
text: Somewhere in the mountains an explosion thundered and smoke rose over the slope. Dwarf sappers had their business.

title: The old miner
text: A grey miner with a pickaxe told of collapsed tunnels beneath the mountain. His words sounded like a warning.

title: Thick fog
text: Fog fell suddenly and the crew had to tie themselves with ropes so as not to get lost. Movement was slow.

title: Waist-deep snow
text: The snow reached the waist and every step took effort. They reached camp exhausted.

title: The ice crown
text: The summit was covered with an ice crown and the sun lit it orange. Everyone looked in awe.

title: The white fox
text: A white fox slipped across the snow like a ghost and vanished. Nobody was sure they saw it.

title: The broken cross
text: A broken cross with names of the dead stood by the path. The crew fixed a fresh piece of wood to it.

title: The cave bear
text: A bear came out of its den and heads for the camp, angry after hibernation. If nobody stops it someone will die.
okText: The bodyguard stood before the bear with a shield and bellowed with all his strength. The beast hesitated and withdrew. Trinkets were found in the den.

title: The falling shard
text: A huge shard of rock falls towards the camp. If nobody stops it it will crush the tents.
okText: The bodyguard braced the rock with his shoulder and held it for a few seconds, enough for everyone to escape. Nobody was hurt.

title: Goblin ambush
text: Goblins planned an ambush on a narrow path. The crew is due to pass that way tomorrow.
okText: The shadow got ahead of the crew, detected the ambush and eliminated the sentries. The crew passed unhindered and took loot from the camp.

title: The mountain thief
text: Someone steals from the crates every night. Half a sack of flour is already gone.
okText: The shadow kept watch in the gloom and caught the thief: a hungry mountain fox. Instead of killing it he fed it and gained a warning companion.

title: Eagles in the sky
text: Eagles circle over the crew clearly preparing to attack. The sentries are anxious.
okText: The marksman shot down two eagles swiftly, the rest fled. The crew had roast meat and feathers for arrows.

title: The stranded ibex
text: A mountain ibex with enormous horns is stuck on a ledge above the camp. It's out of reach without a precise shot.
okText: The marksman hit the ibex in the heart with an arrow from a great distance. The hide and horns were worth a few coins.

title: The miners' quarrel
text: Two miners quarrelled over a vein of ore. If nobody separates them there'll be bloodshed.
okText: The provocateur persuaded both that the quarrel is a matter of the noble craft and proposed a contest of best finds. Both agreed and paid for the arbitration.

title: The suspicious pilgrim
text: A pilgrim with a staff and thick cloak pays too much attention to your things. Either a spy or a thief.
okText: The provocateur invited him to talk and after an hour the pilgrim confessed he's a customs agent. The crew offered him a gift for silence.

title: Strange nuggets
text: Strange black nuggets lie in the stream, heavy and cold. Nobody knows what they are.
okText: The scavenger examined the nuggets and recognised a rare ore. The crew sold it to the Dwarfs for a good price.

title: Rusty armours
text: Rusty armours of ancient warriors lie in a cave. They're old but a few pieces can be repaired.
okText: The scavenger mended a few pieces and sold them to a smith. The profit was considerable and the remaining pieces decorated the camp.

title: Smuggling over the ridge
text: Goods must be carried over the ridge but the road is narrow and slippery. The mules risk falling.
okText: The carter led the mules along a trail known only to him, blindfolding them. All arrived safely and the pay was generous.

title: The overturned wagon
text: A wagon with ore overturned on a steep slope and the goods lie scattered. The owners beg for help.
okText: The carter reloaded the wagon, fixed the wheel and led it to the trail. The owners paid in ore.

title: The Dwarf dam
text: Dwarfs built a dam that cuts off water to nearby villages. The villagers ask for help.
okText: The arsonist mined the dam and blew it so water flowed to the villages. The villagers paid in food and coins.

title: The falling boulder
text: A huge boulder hangs over the path to a mine threatening collapse. Someone could make use of it.
okText: The arsonist laid a charge so the boulder fell at the right moment onto a patrol. The crew gathered loot without losses of their own.

title: The companion's disappearance
text: One of the followers vanished in the night leaving only tracks in the snow. He must be found before he freezes.
okText: The scout followed the trail and found the companion in a cave dizzy with his foot in a trap. The rescued shared his find.

title: The shortcut
text: The crew needs a shortcut across the mountains because soldiers approach from the west. The road must be safe and fast.
okText: The scout led the crew along a hidden path nobody knew of. They lost the soldiers and found a good spot for camp on the way.

title: Stolen ore
text: Someone offers the crew bars of ore stolen from a mine. It looks like an opportunity but risky.
okText: The fence checked the origin, contacted a dealer from another town and resold at a large profit. Everyone got richer.

title: The forged document
text: A wanderer offers a document with a Dwarf crest said to open roads. It looks authentic.
okText: The fence examined the seal, recognised a forgery and sold it to someone who needed it. He profited and offended nobody.

title: The bear wound
text: One follower has a deep wound from bear claws. He bleeds and pales.
okText: The healer stitched the wound, washed it with a decoction and wrapped it in herbs. The patient survived and expressed gratitude by offering his only valuables.

title: Winter melancholy
text: Part of the crew sinks into a grim mood seeing only white and rock. They speak of hopelessness.
okText: The healer brewed a tea of odd herbs and told a colourful tale of warm summer. Spirits improved and laughter returned.

title: Duel with a Dwarf
text: A Dwarf challenged your men to an axe duel. If you refuse the offended Dwarf pride will be spoken of for ages.
okText: The duellist agreed to a cudgel duel and beat the Dwarf in the first round then bowed and offered him ale. The Dwarf accepted.

title: The count on the mountain path
text: A count with a retinue stopped on a narrow path and demands right of way. The crew doesn't want to yield.
okText: The duellist stepped forward and courteously proposed a duel of words. The count lost gracefully and left a purse.

title: The lost dog
text: A large dog in a leather collar wandered into camp with an injured paw. He looks like a prized sheepdog.

title: The shepherds arrive
text: After a few days shepherds come looking for the dog. They thank the crew and reward it with a few cheeses and coins.

title: The odd cave sound
text: An irregular knocking comes from a cave as if someone hammered in the rock. Nobody knows who.

title: The smith in the rock
text: It turns out to be a hidden Dwarf making valuable items. He proposes trade and asks for discretion.

title: The child in the snow
text: A child wrapped in a blanket was found in the snow by the path. Chilled but alive.

title: The child's parents
text: The child's parents, highlanders, came for it and wept for joy. They gave all they had and promised to hide the crew from the army.

title: The smashed statue
text: A statue of a Dwarf was smashed with a hammer. Fragments lie about and fresh marks show on the plinth.

title: The Dwarf vendetta
text: A group of Dwarfs hunts those guilty of smashing the statue. If the crew is mistaken for the culprits it'll go badly.

title: The foreign song
text: From inside the mountain a low song rises, not human. The crew stands by the rock listening.

title: The mine entrance
text: The crew found a hidden entrance to an abandoned mine. Inside the smell of damp and old tools and a few chests.

title: The pass in the clouds
text: The crew stood above the clouds. Below lay a white carpet and above only sun and rock.

title: Cracking ice
text: The ice on the lake cracked with a bang like cannon shots. The crew camped on the shore and didn't sleep till morning.

title: The viper
text: A viper basked on a stone and hissed when someone approached. Everyone stepped back carefully.

title: Rock carvings
text: Wind erosion carved shapes like human faces in the rocks. The crew looked with a shiver.

title: The small waterfall
text: A waterfall murmured beside the camp and the water was icy and clear. Everyone filled their skins and washed their faces.

title: The forgotten camp
text: The crew came upon a camp abandoned in haste: a kettle, a few blankets and still-warm ashes.

title: The bat cave
text: Thousands of bats hung in the cave. The crew skirted it widely not wanting to startle them.

title: Winter sleep
text: The crew fell asleep in a silence so deep that in the morning nobody remembered dreams. They rested perfectly.

title: Cries from the valleys
text: From below came cries of people lost in the blizzard. The crew went to find them and led them to camp.

title: The summit
text: The crew climbed to a summit from which the whole valley was visible. Everyone felt great and immortal.

title: Mountain locusts
text: A cloud of insects flew over the valley. The crew watched them as wonders.

title: The Dwarf graveyard
text: The crew came upon a Dwarf graveyard where every grave bore carved runes. Nobody dared touch anything.

title: The wanderer with a staff
text: An old pilgrim with a staff crossed the pass and waved. They waved back.

title: Cloud of smoke
text: A cloud of mine smoke rose over the valley. The crew knew a settlement was nearby.

title: Thundering echo
text: One follower's shout came back as an echo several times. A game began and then someone ordered everyone quiet.

title: Fossils
text: Fossils of strange creatures lay among the rocks. The scavenger gathered a few believing someone would buy them.

title: A fresh track
text: A fresh bootprint was visible in the snow leading to the camp and away again. Someone watched us but took nothing.

title: Frost and sun
text: The morning was frosty but sunny and hoarfrost glittered on every rock. The crew rose with new strength.

title: Eagle screams
text: Eagles called to each other across the valley and the echo rolled along the slopes. Everyone looked up.

title: Stone steps
text: Stone steps were carved into the rock leading to a narrow terrace. The crew slept there sheltered from the wind.

title: Vines in the cave
text: In the depths of the cave vines grew as if sun once reached here. The crew looked at them in disbelief.

title: Fog and whispers
text: Fog filled the pass and whispers sounded within. The crew halted and waited for it to clear.

title: Golden flowers
text: Golden flowers grew among the rocks said to bring luck. The crew gathered a few.

title: The living stone
text: A stone on the path moved and then went still again. Everyone stepped aside and walked on without looking back.

title: Stone needles
text: Rock spires stuck up like fingers. The crew camped between them sheltered from the wind.

title: White down
text: Snow fell softly all night muffling every sound. By morning the world was immaculately white.

title: Good ale
text: A wandering Dwarf treated the crew to ale worth a thousand crowns. Nobody complained there was nothing to eat with it.

title: The rock bastion
text: The crew pitched camp on a hilltop with a view of every approach. They felt safe.

title: Stars
text: The sky was so clear every star could be seen. Everyone lay on their backs looking up in silence.

title: The wandering bard
text: A bard with a lute stopped for the night and played late. The crew sang along and the cold stopped mattering.

title: The enraged troll
text: A troll came out of a cave and lumbers towards the camp swinging a club. If nobody stops him the camp will be crushed.
okText: The bodyguard stood before the troll and drew him into a trap where rocks fell. The troll died and treasure was found in the cave.

title: Crossing on ice
text: An ice bridge leads over a chasm and the supplies are heavy. Somebody must carry them.
okText: The bodyguard carried all the crates on his own back one after another and lost not one.

title: The spy in camp
text: A suspicious wanderer circles the camp gathering information. If he gets away he'll betray your position.
okText: The shadow tracked him in the night, knocked him out and searched his things. He found a map and payment from the enemy.

title: The slope and the shade
text: A figure in a dark cloak appeared on the slope watching the camp. It hasn't moved in hours.
okText: The shadow climbed the rocks, came up from behind and found it was a statue in a cloak left by earlier travellers. The cloak held coins.

title: The eagle's temptation
text: An eagle took a follower's cap and circles above the camp with it. Everyone laughs but the cap was valuable.
okText: The marksman hit the eagle so that it dropped the cap without being hurt. The cap returned to its owner.

title: The stone boar
text: A great boar appeared on the slope destroying whatever it meets. It heads towards the camp.
okText: The marksman killed the boar with one shot to the forehead. There was so much meat it lasted a week.

title: The noble caravan
text: A noble caravan stopped on the pass and seeks entertainment. Everyone is bored.
okText: The provocateur organised a mule race that amused the whole caravan. The nobles paid generously and promised a good word with the count.

title: Rumours in the settlement
text: A rumour circulates in a mountain settlement that the crew robs travellers. The locals look askance.
okText: The provocateur spread contrary rumours: that another crew prowls the area. The locals believed it and the crew got supplies as a reward.

title: The wagon on the rocks
text: A merchant's wagon crashed on the rocks and the goods scattered. Someone resourceful might profit.
okText: The scavenger gathered everything useful and packed it into sacks. He returned with supplies and coins.

title: The lost gear
text: On the slope lies a climber's pack with equipment and ropes. The owner isn't to be seen.
okText: The scavenger went through the pack, took useful things and set the rest aside in case someone claimed it. The gains were decent.

title: Smuggling through snow
text: Goods must reach the other side of the pass but snow buried the trail. An idea is needed.
okText: The carter made a sled of planks and dragged the goods over snow. The sale on the other side brought a large profit.

title: Mule in the abyss
text: A mule with a valuable load slipped and hangs over the chasm on a rope. If it snaps the cargo is lost.
okText: The carter hauled the mule up by hand saving both animal and cargo. The owner paid generously.

title: The castle on the hill
text: The count's castle stands on a hill and a treasure lies in its cellars. The wall can't be bypassed.
okText: The arsonist laid a charge under the wall at night and brought it down with a blast. In the confusion the crew took the treasure and fled.

title: The icy path
text: The path to the mine is icy and dangerous. Someone must thaw it before merchants fall.
okText: The arsonist lit fires along the path and melted the ice. Merchants passed safely and paid for the effort.

title: The treasure map
text: A map with a cross was found in an old hut. The marks on it look genuine.
okText: The scout followed the map and reached a cave where he found a chest of coins. The crew grew richer.

title: The lost caravan
text: A merchant caravan got lost in a blizzard and wanders the slope. It seeks a guide.
okText: The scout found the caravan by its tracks and led it to the trail. The merchants gave part of their goods in thanks.

title: The false bar
text: A dealer offers a gold bar at a reasonable price. On closer inspection it looks suspicious.
okText: The fence recognised the forgery and demanded a fair price or return. The dealer paid compensation and fled.

title: Hide buying
text: A hide dealer buys anything the crew has but offers a very low price. The crew must haggle.
okText: The fence haggled for an hour pointing out flaws in the competition's goods and extracted a price twice the initial one.

title: The sharp cough
text: Several followers have coughed for days and their breaths wheeze. If it worsens they won't get far.
okText: The healer brewed a herbal tea with honey and onion and by morning everyone breathed lighter. A few paid for the recipe.

title: Superstition of the mountain
text: The crew ended up in a place said by legend to be cursed. Half refuse to continue.
okText: The healer performed a cleansing ritual with salt and herbs and then pointed out a safe path. The crew moved on.

title: The count's guard
text: A count's guard stopped the crew at the pass demanding toll. He's stubborn and proud.
okText: The duellist challenged the guard to a duel of words and fencing, beat him in a few moves and was let through free.

title: The path of honour
text: Two knights block a narrow path demanding an oath of loyalty from the crew. Refusal is an insult.
okText: The duellist proposed a joint tournament, won against both and was declared a worthy friend. The knights gave a prize.

title: The strange plaque
text: Someone placed a plaque on the rock with a few words in an unknown alphabet. It seems new.

title: The translation
text: A wandering scholar translated the plaque: it points to a hidden treasure. He asks to join and offers a share.

title: The chest on the slope
text: A chest hung on a rope over a chasm was found on the slope. Nobody knows how it got there.

title: What was in the chest
text: The chest, once recovered, held supplies and a letter requesting the finder: "Deliver my message to Karaz-a-Karak." Payment was promised.

title: The solitary ibex
text: An ibex with ragged horns wanders around the camp without fear. It looks at you calmly.

title: The ibex leads
text: The ibex led the crew along a path among rocks to a hidden valley with lush pastures and a spring. Rest there was wonderful.

title: The stream of bodies
text: The bodies of several animals are frozen into a frozen stream. All look as if someone arranged them.

title: The ring on the ice
text: When the ice melted a ring of stones with a strange symbol was exposed. The crew decided not to stay the night.

title: Camp in a cave
text: The crew lit a fire in a cave and the smoke escaped through a crack in the roof. It was warm and dry.

title: The settlement's folk
text: Highlanders from a nearby settlement came to the camp with gifts. Reluctantly but politely.

title: The broken mirror
text: One follower smashed a small mirror and for the rest of the day walked pale as a wall. He decided misfortune awaited him.

title: Thundering ice
text: A glacier boomed in the distance and the ground shook. Everyone froze waiting for more.

title: Dwarf ale
text: A Dwarf caravan sold the crew a few barrels of dark ale at a bargain price. Everyone was pleased.

title: Alpine roses
text: Alpine roses bloomed on the slope though snow still lay. The crew took it for a good sign.

title: The prospectors
text: Two treasure hunters searched for ore in the stream. The crew watched from hiding and decided not to disturb them.

title: The crumbling ledge
text: The rock ledge on which the camp stood began to crumble. Everyone moved further on losing part of their stores.

title: Snow avalanche
text: An avalanche rolled past the camp by a few metres. Everyone was pale and silent.

title: Spooked mules
text: Mules tore loose and ran into the mountains. The crew chased them for half a day.

title: Stone scrap
text: The crew found an old Dwarf cart on rails. It was rusty but the wheels still turned.

title: Smoke from a high chimney
text: Smoke rose from a high rock as if someone lived there. Nobody dared check.

title: The crystal grotto
text: Crystals were found in a grotto that shone in torchlight like a thousand candles. The crew chipped off a few.

title: The wronged merchant
text: A merchant whose wagon had been robbed wandered the pass asking for shelter. The crew gave him a blanket and a loaf.

title: Barking dogs
text: Sheepdogs barked in the distance and the barking carried across the whole valley. The crew rose listening.

title: Fresh bread
text: A highlander family offered the crew fresh bread from a smoking oven. Nobody asked who you were.

title: The hanged goat
text: A dead goat hung from a tree with ritual marks beneath. The crew didn't pitch camp nearby.

title: The frozen rider
text: On the slope a frozen rider sat on a horse his face covered in rime. The crew buried him and took his horse.

title: First rays
text: The first rays of the sun reached the valley and warmed the camp. Everyone woke with smiles.

title: Red snow
text: The snow around the camp turned red as if covered in dust. The crew ate nothing that touched it.

title: The mountain shrine
text: A small stone shrine stood on the summit with fresh flowers beside it. The crew added theirs.

title: The broken knife
text: In a crack of rock stuck a broken knife of strange shape. The crew looked at it but nobody pulled it out.

title: The woman in black
text: A woman in a black shawl crossed the pass not answering greetings. A smell of herbs remained in the air.

title: Blood on the stone
text: Fresh blood lay on a stone by the path with a piece of torn clothing beside it. The crew moved on more carefully.

title: The hot spring
text: A hot spring steamed in the rock. The crew bathed and rested like never before.

title: Snow desert
text: Endless white stretched in all directions. Everyone felt tiny and lost.

title: The timber cabin
text: A small timber cabin with a fireplace and a stock of firewood waited for stray travellers. The crew ate a hot meal.

title: The mountain smith
text: A mountain smith sharpened the crew's knives and mended equipment for a token fee. He was talkative and merry.

title: Night walk
text: The crew walked at night because by day the wind was too cold. The moon shone bright and the road was visible.

title: Twisted trees
text: Trees on the slope grew twisted by the wind as if someone bent them. The crew walked among them in silence.

title: The stray
text: A skinny chamois wandered into the camp and stayed. The crew named her Hilda.

title: Song of the wind
text: The wind played a tune like singing in the rock fissures. The crew sat in silence and listened.

title: The miner's treasure
text: A dying old miner showed the crew a hiding place with his savings. A box held coins and a simple watch.

title: Pickaxe knocks
text: From deep in the mountain came the knocking of picks, steady and unsettling. Nobody knew who worked there.

title: The wanderer from Nuln
text: A wandering engineer from Nuln measured the mountains with his instruments. The crew watched with curiosity and he told of new roads.

title: The broken bridge
text: The rope bridge over a chasm was broken. The crew had to find a detour losing a whole day.

title: An unusual track
text: Tracks of an unknown animal walking on hind legs were visible in the snow. The crew went in the opposite direction.

title: The abandoned settlement
text: The village below the peak stood empty, doors ajar and coals still glowing in the stoves. The crew didn't stay the night.

title: A look from above
text: A great bird sat atop a rock and looked down. The crew decided not to go that way.

title: The wandering philosopher
text: A grey bearded man in a cloak held forth on the meaning of life by the fire. Nobody understood him but everyone nodded.

title: The mountain tarn
text: A crystal tarn lay in a hollow ringed by rocks. The crew washed and drank their fill.

title: Falling pebbles
text: Small pebbles fell above the camp as if someone walked on the rocks. By morning there were no tracks.

title: The old statue
text: A statue of a hero with an axe stood in the middle of a disused road. The crew paid it respect and moved on.

title: The searched cave
text: The crew found a cave someone had searched before them. Nothing valuable was left but the roof was dry.

title: A sharp whistle
text: A sharp whistle cut the air and then an impact on the rock right beside. Someone shot a sling or crossbow.

title: Escaped labourers
text: A group of escaped mine labourers begged food. The crew shared what it had.

title: The avalanche's visit
text: A small avalanche buried part of the camp. Everyone dug themselves out and laughed nervously.

title: The Dwarf road
text: The crew found a Dwarf road of even stones with carefully carved runes. They walked it with respect.

title: Eagles fighting
text: Two eagles fought in the air above the camp and feathers fell like snow. The crew watched in awe.

title: The stone capsule
text: A stone capsule with a sealed letter lay in a crevice. The crew took it out and read: "For whoever finds it."

title: Hypothermia
text: One follower chilled so deep he lost feeling in his fingers. The crew warmed him by the fire and gave a hot drink.

title: The foothill village
text: The village at the foot of the mountain was lit with fires and singing came from the inn. The crew counted another night won.

title: Smoke and Dwarfs
text: Dwarf smiths lit furnaces on the slope and smoke rose like fog. The noise of hammers lasted all night.

title: A suspicious mist
text: A greenish mist rose from a cave smelling of rot. The crew backed off a hundred paces.

title: The black stone
text: A black stone stuck out of the slope cold as ice even in full sun. Nobody touched it.

title: Frozen horses
text: The crew's horses stood stiff and steamed in the frosty air. In the morning they had to be warmed for an hour.

title: The stranger in the cabin
text: In a cabin on the slope lives a lone old man who doesn't open the door. Smoke rises from the chimney day and night.

title: The hermit opens
text: After a few days the hermit came out of the cabin and invited the crew in. It turned out he needed help fixing the roof and pays in coins.

title: The howling wind
text: At night a howling was heard that seemed to come from inside the mountain. Everyone covered their ears.

title: The source of the howl
text: The crew found a fissure from which the wind blew. Inside lay skeletons and a few old coins.

title: The winged shadow
text: A great shadow flew over the camp blotting the moon. Everyone froze.

title: The giant's nest
text: The crew found the nest of an enormous bird with sheep bones and... a gold ring. The bird wasn't guarding it but could return any moment.

title: The frozen treasure
text: A glittering object is visible in a block of ice. The ice is thick and the object looks valuable.

title: The ice melts
text: After a few days the sun melted the ice and exposed a golden sculpture. Someone must take it before others do.

title: The smell of snow
text: The air smelled of clean snow. Everyone breathed deeply and even the most tired smiled.

title: The chamois and kids
text: A chamois with two kids grazed on the slope. The crew watched them leap over rocks with a dancer's lightness.

title: The stranger in a cloak
text: A stranger in a fur cloak walked through the camp without a word and vanished in the blizzard. He left a gold coin by the fire.

title: A knock on the rock
text: Someone or something knocked rhythmically on the rock above the camp, three times, then fell silent. Nobody slept till morning.

title: The falling beam
text: A beam from an old mine fell from a ledge and shattered right by the camp. Everyone moved away.

title: Ruined tower
text: The ruins of an old watchtower stood above the pass. The crew examined them and found nothing valuable but the place was dry.

title: Temperature drop
text: The temperature fell so sharply the water in the skins froze within minutes. Everyone shivered by the fire.

title: The friendly highlander
text: A highlander with a snowy beard invited the crew to his cabin and told of paths that aren't on maps. Everyone listened closely.

title: The Bretonnian traveller
text: A traveller from Bretonnia stopped for the night and told of knights and ladies. He was amusing and very hungry.

title: Carrion in the snow
text: The carcass of a mountain chamois lay in the snow untouched by predators. The crew skirted it not knowing what killed it.

title: The buried shrine
text: The roof of a small shrine stuck out of a drift. The crew dug out the entrance and found dry wood and a candle stub inside.

title: Wind in the crevices
text: The wind whistled in the rock crevices so loud conversation was impossible. Nobody slept peacefully.

title: The lost wanderer
text: A wanderer with frostbitten fingers stumbled into the camp barely alive. The crew warmed and fed him.

title: The starved wolf
text: A gaunt wolf watched the camp from a few paces. A piece of meat was thrown to it and it left without a word.

title: Frost on beards
text: In the morning everyone had frost on beards and eyebrows. They laughed at themselves but nobody wanted to leave bed.

title: The resting place
text: On the pass lay an old stone tomb with Dwarf runes carved on it. The crew circled it respectfully.

title: A heavy night
text: Cold and wind gave no sleep and trees creaked like bones. By morning everyone had dark-ringed eyes.

title: The snow sculpture
text: Someone carved a man-sized bear from the snow. The crew didn't know whether to laugh or fear.

title: Half a day in the tunnel
text: The crew passed through a long tunnel cut in the rock. Inside it was quiet, dry and strangely warm.

title: Ill winds
text: The wind changed direction and brought a smell of smoke and burning. The crew was uneasy but nothing happened.

title: The merchants' camp
text: The merchants of a caravan let the crew settle by their fire. Gossip and a little food were exchanged.

title: The barking dog
text: A stray dog barked at the crew from afar and then fled. Nobody knew where it came from.

title: Stone corridors
text: The crew found old stone corridors hewn into the rock by unknown builders. The entrances were blocked but one led to a dry chamber.

title: The first star
text: The first star twinkled above the peaks and the camp fell quiet. Someone began humming an old song.

title: Shepherds' children
text: Shepherds' children played hide-and-seek on the slope. The crew watched from afar and noticed one looked a lot like a follower.

title: The wanderer without a shadow
text: In the torchlight a wanderer who sat by the fire cast no shadow. The crew quietly withdrew.

title: The falling avalanche
text: An avalanche crashed from a distant peak with a roar and then silence settled. Everyone watched where the sound came from.

title: The mule train
text: A long train of mules crossed the pass and the guide nodded in greeting. The crew returned the gesture.

title: The petrified forest
text: The crew came upon an area covered in petrified trunks. The trees looked as if someone had stopped time.

title: The lost shawl
text: A woman's shawl embroidered with beautiful patterns lay on a stone. The crew took it and waited but nobody claimed it.

title: Frost and joy
text: The frost was so strong everyone jumped and clapped to warm up. It looked like a dance and the crew laughed till morning.

title: Rumbles from the depths
text: Dull rumbles came from deep in the mountain as if something moved underground. The crew camped at the edge of the valley.

title: The shepherd's song
text: From afar came a shepherd's song played on a horn. Everyone fell silent listening to the melody.

title: The buried wagon
text: A merchant's wagon half buried lay beside the path. The crew dug it out and took a few things that survived.

title: The lone cabin
text: A lone cabin stood in a hollow with smoke rising from the chimney. The crew went round without disturbing the occupants.

title: Four crows
text: Four crows sat on the rock edge and looked down. The crew backed off and chose another road.

title: Ice in the skins
text: Ice in the skins melted slowly and nobody could drink. The crew had to melt it in a kettle.

title: Lanterns on the pass
text: Someone placed lanterns on the pass that shone all night. The crew didn't know if it was a guide or a trap.

title: Two billy goats
text: Two billy goats fought on a rock butting horns. The crew bet on which would win.

title: The pouch under the rock
text: Someone hid a pouch with a few coins and a letter under a rock. The crew took the coins and left the letter.

title: Crumbling cliffs
text: Cliffs above the trail crumbled in the night and by morning the trail was buried in stones. The crew laboriously cleared them.

title: Honeyed dawns
text: An aurora lit the sky in green and pink. The crew watched not believing their eyes.

title: The wanderer with a lamp
text: A lone wanderer with a lamp walked across the pass not responding to calls. The crew watched him vanish into the dark.

title: The sealed cave
text: The cave mouth sealed behind one follower trapping him for hours. He was pulled out through a hole.

title: The little bell
text: Somewhere in the mountains a sheep bell rang though there were no sheep. The crew decided not to seek the source.

title: Treasure in the stone
text: One follower split a stone and found a glittering crystal inside. Not valuable but beautiful.

title: River of ice
text: The crew crossed a frozen river that cracked underfoot. Everyone passed unscathed.

title: Sounds of the smith
text: From afar came the sounds of smith's hammers, rhythmic and calm. The crew fell asleep to the rhythm.

title: The weary messenger
text: A messenger in imperial colours stopped at the camp to rest. He said he carries important news but wouldn't say what.

title: Half a day in the mist
text: The crew walked through mist holding hands. Fortunately nobody got lost.

title: The ghost of the shaft
text: Moans came from a sealed mine shaft. The crew preferred not to check whether it was wind.

title: The snowdrift
text: A great snowdrift blocked the trail and the crew had to dig it out. The work took half a day.

title: A handful of gold dust
text: A handful of gold dust was found in one follower's pocket. Nobody knew where it came from.

title: The mysterious parcel
text: Under a rock lay a parcel wrapped in leather with two coins and a note: "For those in need." The crew thanked the unknown benefactor.
